description: Searches the messages in the rooms the person can see, or in one room, newest first. Each hit is a line with who said it, when, the room, and the message id. Use it when someone asks what a group said about something, when it was decided, or who brought it up, and the answer may be older than what rooms_read shows. To read around a hit, call rooms_read with that room and `before` set to a later message id, or `from` set to a time shortly before the hit.

query.description: Keywords or a short phrase; websearch syntax works ("exact phrase", -word, or).

workspace.description: Workspace slug, for tokens without a default.

name: rooms_search
title: Search what rooms said
